# PlasticityInducedAttractorFormation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process by which local synaptic plasticity rules shape the global attractor landscape of a recurrent network, creating stable periodic orbits. Links local biological learning rules to global dynamical properties, providing a mechanism for self-organizing computation in neuromorphic hardware.
